description: This file defines the InstallationDatabaseUserAPI class, which is a REST API controller for handling specific installer-related API requests related to database user creation in the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: InstallationDatabaseUserAPI
classes.description: A REST API controller class handling database user setup during the installation process.

methods.name: handlePost
methods.description: Handles the POST request to create a database user during installation by invoking createDBUser on AppSetupUtility.
